blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Two bettors won the ₱390.36 million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draw on Saturday, Nov. 21, 2026. The winning combination was 21-04-29-08-26-09, with the two jackpot winners set to share the total prize of ₱390,356,981.96. READ: Lotto Results Today – November 21, 2026 Meanwhile, no bettor won the ₱10 million Lotto 6/42 jackpot. The winning numbers were 17-33-10-30-26-19. According to the PCSO results, two bettors also won the 6D Lotto top prize of ₱4.88 million with the winning combination 1-3-0-8-3-8.
